This place fixes a bad travel day.

Sunset Beach Bar & Restaurant on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Cold drink in hand, feet near the sand, sky turning orange. 2,272 people rated it 4.3 stars for a reason.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
